keyEvents.text: Goal! Ajax 1, ADO Den Haag 0. Davy Klaassen (Ajax) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Oscar Gloukh.
Goal! Ajax 2, ADO Den Haag 0. Jorthy Mokio (Ajax) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Davy Klaassen.
Matteo Waem (ADO Den Haag) is shown the red card.
Substitution, ADO Den Haag. Lasse Wilhelm replaces Yannick Eduardo.
Goal! Ajax 3, ADO Den Haag 0. Davy Klaassen (Ajax) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Lucas Rosa with a cross following a fast break.
First Half ends, Ajax 3, ADO Den Haag 0.
Substitution, ADO Den Haag. Sékou Sylla replaces Matej Sín.
Substitution, ADO Den Haag. Jonas Jensen-Abbew replaces Mylian Jiménez.
Second Half begins Ajax 3, ADO Den Haag 0.
Substitution, Ajax. Anton Gaaei replaces Lucas Rosa.
Substitution, Ajax. Oliver Edvardsen replaces Oscar Gloukh.
Substitution, Ajax. Marcos Leonardo replaces Tolu Arokodare.
Substitution, Ajax. Steven Berghuis replaces Rayane Bounida.
Substitution, Ajax. Julian Brandt replaces Davy Klaassen.
Anton Gaaei (Ajax) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Sékou Sylla (ADO Den Haag).
Delay in match because of an injury Jorthy Mokio (Ajax).
Substitution, ADO Den Haag. Daryl van Mieghem replaces Othniël Raterink.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, ADO Den Haag. Jesse Bal replaces Nigel Thomas.
